description: Three-phase energy meter with Modbus RTU: energy, power, voltage, current, power factor and demand as floats and integers, plus configuration and diagnostics
source: Continental Control Systems, WattNode Modbus Installation and Operation Manual, Rev 1.18c (firmware 18-24)

sources.title: WattNode Modbus Installation and Operation Manual

notes: Continental Control Systems WattNode Modbus (WNC and RWNC revenue models). Register lists of the manual: basic and advanced measurements, configuration, communication, diagnostics and option information.
This map also replaces the older generic 'Wattnode' map of this library, which was the first 50 floating-point registers of the same table, converted from a third-party list.
The manual numbers registers from 1 (EnergySum is 1001, sent as 1000 on the wire), so this map uses address_base 1 with the manual's numbers. Holding (03) and input (04) reads are interchangeable.
32-bit values (float and integer) are low word first (word order little), as the manual says. The custom register map can swap the words; this map assumes the factory setting.

Each measurement is available as a float (1001-1199) and as an integer (1201-1399, names ending in '(integer)'). Integer energies are 0.1 kWh/kvarh/kVAh; integer powers use PowerIntScale (1609) and integer currents use CurrentIntScale (1622).
Energies marked RW can be preset or reset (ZeroEnergy, 1620); the NR energies cannot.

registers.name: IoPinMode

registers.name: ApplyComConfig
registers.description: Writing 1234 applies the configuration settings below. Reads 1 if changes not applied yet. Default 0.

registers.description: Modbus address (if non-zero, overrides DIP switches). Default 0.

registers.name: BaudRate

registers.name: ParityMode

registers.name: ReplyDelay
